title: Classic Crepes
description: Thin, tender French crepes made from a quick blender batter. Fill them sweet with jam or lemon and sugar, or savory with ham and cheese.

image.alt: Folded crepes with berries and powdered sugar

ingredients.prep: melted, plus more for the pan

steps.text: Blend the flour, milk, eggs, melted butter, sugar and salt until completely smooth, scraping down the sides once. Let the batter rest in the fridge for at least {time 30 min notimer} so the crepes are tender.
Heat the skillet over medium heat and brush it with a little butter. Stir the batter, which may have separated.
Pour in about {qty 1/4 cup fixed} of batter while tilting and swirling the pan so it coats the bottom in a thin, even layer.
Cook until the edges lift and the underside is lightly golden, {time 1 min}. Loosen with a spatula, flip and cook the second side for {time 20-30 sec}.
Slide the crepe onto a plate and repeat with the rest of the batter, stacking them. Brush the pan with butter every couple of crepes. The first one is often a test; that’s normal.

notes: Stacked crepes keep, wrapped, in the fridge for 3 days or frozen for 2 months. Warm them in a dry pan.
Classic fillings: lemon juice and sugar, jam, sliced bananas with chocolate spread, or ham and grated cheese warmed in the pan.
